actions.action: Lift the pot to check weight/waterlogging
Inspect stem bases and roots for rot
Check location for windows, doors, radiators
Stop watering until top few cm dry and pot lighter
Move plant away from cold windows/drafts/heating to 15-20°C spot
If rot: unpot, cut away mushy parts, dry a day, repot in fresh well-draining mix in pot with drainage hole
Cut off firm segment and root it in moist mix

reason: The answer diagnoses overwatering/root rot and cold stress, but the plants were underwatered, so telling the owner to stop watering would have deepened the drought and delayed the fix.
